Highlights

  1. The roster is one act away from zero mechanical-registration infrastructure: 1,138 of 1,314 own-release tracks (87%) across 19 DSP-present acts have no MLC work identified via artist sweeps, writer legal-name sweeps, or title match. Excluding Caponeti, coverage for the other 18 acts is roughly 5%. Counts are recordings, not deduped compositions.
  2. Caponeti (writer Dylan Cotton) is the in-roster proof of what done-right looks like: 159 works at ~100% known shares through his own CAPONETI imprint plus Songtrust — 86% of a 131-track catalog linked. His remaining 18 recent tracks are a clean maintenance filing batch.
  3. Aphrodite 7 (36.9k monthly listeners) is the cleanest apparent gap: her writer identity (Vivian Clara Adundo, spelled four ways in label metadata) is evidenced on the two collab works that exist, and on both no publishing/admin claim attributable to her interest was identified. Her other 34 own tracks have no MLC work. Exact entitlement is TBD from split documentation.
  4. Dj Zelus (71.1k listeners) has no evidenced writer identity anywhere: his three linked works are claimed by co-writers' publishers (NEW TOMORROW MG; GlobalGang/Sony ATV Cross Keys), and no MLC works exist under 'DJ Zelus' or the credited 'Xander Spike'.
  5. DJ Ess (860.8k listeners) is a mix catalog: the registered compositions belong to the source artists (EvilGiane/Surf Gang, Empire Strikes First, Kosign, ENRGY). He is listed as a co-writer on three mix works with no IPI and no attributable claim identified. Master side (SoundExchange) is not covered here and is his bigger conversation.
  6. ELYSÍA (24.6k listeners) is at 0% coverage with a live identity hazard: none of her 52 own tracks have an MLC work, her credited name (Elysia Xia) sweeps to zero, and 'Elysia' is shared at the MLC by several registered strangers. Pin her identity (IPI, ISWCs) before any filing.
  7. Zee! has infrastructure that stopped being fed: 18 works registered via SONGTRUST BLVD at 100% (writer Zevonte Stokes), but only 6 of 139 own tracks link and 133 show no work. Whether Songtrust is still active is an onboarding question — if it is, this is a backlog, not a new setup.
  8. Trenchbabyeli is the volume case with a linkage anomaly: 236 own tracks (the roster's largest catalog), zero linked; two works owned by unrelated writers carry recordings displaying 'Trenchbabyeli' — potentially incorrect work-recording linkage requiring delink/dispute review.
  9. Identity hygiene is a roster-wide workstream: Machine Boy 2007 releases as 'machineboyxx'; Myir has a duplicate Spotify profile; Ivyanna shares her exact artist name with a CD Baby-registered stranger; Nick Andree and caponeti each have second Spotify profiles; ELYSÍA has two Deezer profiles; label metadata spells Aphrodite 7's legal name four ways. Fix identities before mass filing.
  10. Producers Sxxmmyy and Crew Beatz00 have no DSP catalogs under those names (YouTube-only) — nothing to sweep yet; their placements would be captured through the artists' filings via split documentation.
